I Don't Own a Smartphone

by Joe Blogs

  1. History of smartphones

    • texting.
    • phone calls.
    • smartphone stagnation.
    • government tracking.

  2. Reasons why I don't own a smartphone.

    • It's bad for your health.
      • Posture
      • Eyesight
      • Sleep
      • EMF?
    • Digital content
      • Nonsence content wastes your time.
      • Internalize things unconsciously introjection
      • You don't pilot your experience, you sit back and get served content.
    • Phones as a defence mechanism.
      • illusion of maintaining contact with others.
    • Convenience sacifices autonomy
      • dependence on GPS maps
      • computer literacy
      • learned helplessness

  3. It feels weird to not have a smartphone.
